/bench/repo/docs/plans/2026-04-06-memo-mentions/design.md:53:Teach `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` to resolve mention metadata while rebuilding tags and properties. The extraction step should walk the markdown AST once, collect raw `@username` tokens, resolve them to active users via the store, deduplicate by `user_id`, and populate `memo.Payload.Mentions`. `*markdown.service` (Goldmark; sole implementation, `internal/markdown/markdown.go`) — `apiv1.NewAPIV1Service` calls `markdown.NewService`; `server.NewServer` passes the instance to RSS (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go`, `server/server.go`) — `APIV1Service`, `RSSService`, and `memopayload.Runner` hold `markdown.Service` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go`, `server/router/rss/rss.go`, `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`).
